chunks: There is no charity while a needy close relative exists.

key_terms.ذُو رَحِمٍ: a close relative connected by kinship

ai.seo_question: Who has greater right to charity when a close relative is in need?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that one should not overlook needy relatives while giving charity elsewhere. It emphasizes the greater claim of close kin upon a person's wealth when they are in need.
